original_test_intent: Exit a known SDR repository update-mode transaction through the supported path and prove the intended pending-data disposition, repository availability and restored sensor monitoring.
original_method: Master remains TBD. Review uses standard Storage 0x0a/0x2b only as a target-approved candidate after ownership and transaction-state checks.
manual_activity: The repository transaction owner confirms that exit is expected now, whether it commits/finalizes/aborts pending data, and who owns recovery if post-state is inconsistent.
required_inputs: Evidence that update mode is active
Pending repository operation and completion state
safety_requirements: Never issue exit as a blind generic recovery
Do not terminate an unknown owner's transaction
Do not mutate SDR or reset chassis to hide a mismatch
Stop and escalate on ambiguous completion
agent_execution_scope: Verify target, update-mode state and owner
Capture pending operation and repository baseline
Present exact exit effect for confirmation
Verify repository reads/reservations and sensor monitoring
Return evidence or hand off to recovery owner
engineer_actions: Define target-specific exit acceptance and recovery
Own any incomplete repository outcome and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek appropriately prevents an undefined state transition but does not distinguish a packageable exit from permanent inability to review.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner/state confirmation, issue the protected target-approved equivalent of `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x2b` once and independently verify repository and monitoring post-state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source TBD and 10/5 timing fields remain intact; no owner, transaction state or exit effect is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind exit to the verified owning transaction, record its pending-data outcome and prove repository plus monitoring recovery after a single confirmed transition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds Review-layer ownership, pre-state, post-state and escalation checkpoints without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Querying update-mode status is partial evidence only; the required exit transition and resulting repository state must be observed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An incorrect exit can abort or finalize incomplete sensor definitions, leaving repository contents logically corrupt even when the command returns success.

project_override_considerations: A vendor exit API is equivalent only when transaction ownership, pending-data semantics, transition completion and post-exit monitoring are traceable. A generic reset is not an acceptable substitute.
expected_evidence: Fresh owner approval and transaction identity
Post-exit repository access/reservation and record integrity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master title specifies an exit transition, but Procedure/Criteria are TBD and the boilerplate clears evidence. It omits ownership, pending-data behavior and post-exit acceptance, which must be added only in the Review layer.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is identifiable; ownership, state and firmware semantics can be supplied as project execution inputs. The review can complete without falsely authorizing a blind exit.

review_improvement: Prevents an exit from aborting or finalizing an unknown repository transaction and makes post-exit repository integrity and monitoring health mandatory evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Exit is context-sensitive: the same command can be a clean close or a harmful interruption depending on the pending repository operation. Therefore target identity, owner and data disposition must be established before one confirmed transition, followed by content and monitoring checks; this warrants packaged execution rather than unattended automation.
